{{Top|leg}}
The '''Corporate Sector Charter''' was the official document that laid out the foundation of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. The Charter laid out the structure of the Authority, as well as the responsibilities of the companies investing in the venture.
